profile.summary: Sales executive with 14+ years of direct experience in B2B sales, account management, and business development across medical, collections, and laboratory services sectors. Demonstrated track record of scaling revenue (grew placements from $100K to $2.5M monthly), building and managing sales teams, and acquiring major enterprise clients. Expertise in consultative selling, territory management, client retention, and CRM platforms. Skilled at prospecting, closing complex deals, and training sales staff in new markets.
